name: philosophy-of-design
description: John Ousterhout's A Philosophy of Software Design as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for deep modules, information hiding, narrow interfaces, defining errors away and strategic design.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short A Philosophy of Software Design rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
